title: uhi-evaluation-methods: code for the evaluation of urban heat island evaluation methods in a convection-permitting regional climate model

creators.name: Vandelanotte, Kobe
creators.affiliation: Ghent University; Royal Meteorological Institute of Belgium

creators.name: Top, Sara
creators.affiliation: Ghent University; Royal Meteorological Institute of Belgium; Vrije Universiteit Brussel

description: Quality control of urban climate network and meteorological service observations, the seven urban heat island (UHI) evaluation methods (p2p, a2a, p2a) and the figures and tables of the accompanying paper on how the choice of UHI evaluation method affects the assessment of a convection-permitting regional climate model for nine European cities. Includes a modified copy of URCLIMASK (Apache-2.0, Copyright 2023 European Union).
